scripts.build:simulator: pnpm --filter ./apps/mobile exec eas build --profile simulator --platform all --non-interactive
scripts.build:simulator:ios: pnpm --filter ./apps/mobile exec eas build --profile simulator --platform ios --non-interactive
scripts.build:simulator:android: pnpm --filter ./apps/mobile exec eas build --profile simulator --platform android --non-interactive
scripts.build:android: pnpm --filter ./apps/mobile exec eas build --profile development --platform android
scripts.build:ios: pnpm --filter ./apps/mobile exec eas build --profile development --platform ios
scripts.build:mobile:dev: pnpm --filter ./apps/mobile exec eas build --profile development --platform all
scripts.build:mobile:prod: pnpm --filter ./apps/mobile exec eas build --profile production --platform all
